decision.reason: Turkcell original 13 October public announcement confirms new intelligent-surface 3.7GHz/26GHz field testing; RAN engineers need pilot evidence tracking and before/after coverage comparison.

opportunities.idea_name: RIS Saha Kapsama Pilot Kanıt Defteri
opportunities.core_job: Verify RF coverage improvement of reconfigurable intelligent surfaces in RAN field pilots without direct network integration
opportunities.target_customer: Mobil operatör radyo planlama ve saha kabul test mühendisleri
opportunities.product_mechanism: Kullanıcı CSV ile baz/test RIS ölçümleri, 3.7GHz/26GHz, sahaya özgü anten-geometri bilgisi, ölçüm güven aralığı, test sürümü ve insan kabul onayını girer; deterministik kapsama farkı karşılaştırır
opportunities.why_now: Turkcell and TÜBİTAK announced their first prototype intelligent-surface field tests on commercial-grade RF environments on 13 October 2026, including 3.7 and 26 GHz.
opportunities.before_state: Saha karşılaştırma ölçümleri, site konfigürasyonları ve kabul kararları farklı CSV/test raporlarında, veri kaynağı ve before-after tutarlılığı ayrı takip ediliyor
opportunities.after_state: RIS/site test register → band and control/test measurement CSV → normalized coverage delta → issue/test evidence → reviewer acceptance PDF
opportunities.source_observation: Official Turkcell release names 3.7 GHz and 26 GHz tests, prototypes at Kartal and TÜBİTAK Gebze, and first commercial-like environment testing. Hypothesis, not asserted customer demand.
